title: H11 short-only medium-horizon Donchian trend screen
purpose: Test the minimum H10 revision suggested by H10 direction attribution: retain the frozen short mechanism and remove the failed long branch. A pass permits forward paper validation only.
selection_disclosure: H11 was selected after observing H10 on the same evaluation interval. Results are not independent out-of-sample evidence and cannot authorize live replacement.

data.type: 5m contract klines aggregated to UTC-aligned 4h bars
data.quality_policy: Reuse only HY-EXP-0015 files whose hashes pass its locked manifest; reject duplicate, non-contiguous, incomplete or misaligned bars.

strategy.entry: When a completed 4h close is strictly below the prior 120-bar low, sell at the next 4h open. Long signals are ignored.
strategy.exit: Exit at the next 4h open after a completed close is strictly above the prior 60-bar high, or at the fixed initial two-ATR intrabar stop, whichever occurs first.
strategy.conflict_policy: While open, no new entry or reversal is allowed. Intrabar stop takes precedence over a later close-based channel exit.
strategy.terminal_exit: Liquidate any open position at the close of the last complete 4h bar before the evaluation boundary and charge one exit fill.
strategy.position_policy: At most one short per symbol; no pyramiding; fixed one-sixth research-account allocation per symbol; idle slots earn zero; no compounding.
strategy.funding: Omitted because the public kline screen lacks a causal funding ledger; this limitation must be reported.

accounting.trade_metrics: Win rate and profit factor use each closed position's stressed return on its symbol slot.
accounting.portfolio_metrics: Net return and drawdown scale each trade by one-sixth account allocation; closed-equity drawdown is ordered by exit time and excludes intratrade mark-to-market drawdown.
accounting.monthly_metrics: Attribute one-sixth-scaled stressed return to UTC exit month and include all calendar months touched by the interval, including zero-trade months.
accounting.half_period_metrics: First half contains exits before 2026-02-12T00:00:00Z; second half contains exits at or after that timestamp.

decision.pass: Eligible for a newly frozen forward paper-validation clock; not approved for live replacement.
decision.fail: Eliminate this exact H11 specification and register a materially different H12 before testing.
decision.change_policy: Any feature, threshold, channel, stop, direction, cost, universe or date change requires a new experiment id.
